scene: Inside the rattling mail car, parcels wobble as Gear Bridge fades outside.
beats: The tag flickers into secret vault coordinates just as the mail car glides smoothly into the Lost Property Depot and the doors slide wide.
The automaton tips its cap, sliding an unclaimed silver parcel key into your palm right as the brakes hiss and depot doors open.
The mechanical dove chirps, dropping a vintage baggage ticket into your lap just as the train enters the cavernous depot and doors part open.
picture: Inside a wood-panelled train car, side view along one floor line. On the left, parcels sit on benches, one with a bright glowing tag. In the centre, the player stands beside a four-armed sorting automaton. On the right, windows show moving gears. Up high, a brass dove perches on a rack.
shown: a parcel with a neon blue tag on a bench on the left
a four-armed brass automaton sorting envelopes beside you in the centre
a clockwork dove perched on a high parcel rack up high

after.beat: You stay put as the depot zooms past, rumbling to the line's end. Swapping onto a squeaky window-cleaner gondola, you drift upward toward the churning cloud tanks of Rainmaker Rooftops.

variants.scene: Warm lanterns hum as the clattering mail train leaves Gear Bridge behind.
beats: The neon label blinks to reveal vault numbers just as the train smoothly stops at the Lost Property Depot and the doors glide open.
The busy machine clinks a bow and slips you a shiny silver parcel key right as the car brakes and the depot doors slide open.
With a cheerful click, the tin bird drops an old baggage claim ticket toward your hand as the car rolls in and the doors part.
variants.ride_on: You bypass the bustling platform until the line terminates. Transferring to a squeaking window-washer gondola, you rise up toward the swirling cloud tanks of Rainmaker Rooftops.

variants.scene: Whirring gears echo through the cozy postal car rolling away from Gear Bridge.
beats: Hidden digits for a secret vault flash across the bright tag as the rattling carriage halts at the Lost Property Depot and doors open.
Your helping hand earns a small silver package key from the grateful robot just as wheels squeal and the depot doors hiss wide.
